dct_description_sm: Afghanistan administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 04. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 34 Province - Admin 2: 457 District Dates associated with this dataset: - 23 June 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 26 July 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 23 June 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 June 2026: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Afghanistan](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-afghanistan). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Afghanistan Land Authority (ARAZI), General Statistics and Information Authority (GSIA)
